column1: # Seas and oceans: one row per Natural Earth 10m geography_marine_polys 5.2 feature, joined by (ne_id, ne_name).
# Seeded by places/seed-waters.mjs, then curated by hand (final architecture 2.1): English names in Apple's style,
# Russian names for every row (the owner reviews them), short forms for long names.
# parent: the next larger water body (a chain must end in an ocean; the Caspian is landlocked). whole: the row this
# water is shown as (the halves of the Pacific and Atlantic, the Mediterranean basins, unnamed slivers); empty = itself.
# globe 1: named at the globe tier (the five oceans and the curated major seas); others show their first globe ancestor.
# Disputed water names (Sea of Japan, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Mexico, South China Sea): the UN/IHO English name and the
# standard Russian name, the same for every user (owner decision Q8).
# national 1: a national sea (owner decision Q7): the 22 km band does not apply over it at the regional and city tiers, so
# it shows its own name (the Sea of Marmara, the Bosporus, the Dardanelles: Turkish inland waters), not the coast's country.
